question: Who is known as Sungam Tavirtta Cholan?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kulottunga I**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• **Kulottunga I**, one of the prominent rulers of the Chola dynasty, is renowned for his administration and reforms. He earned the title **"Sungam Tavirtta Cholan"**, which translates to "The Chola who abolished taxes."
 
• The title was earned because Kulottunga I abolished several unpopular taxes, including certain transit duties and other levies, to improve the trade and economy of his kingdom. This reform was highly appreciated by traders and citizens alike.
 
• He ruled the Chola empire from **1070 to 1122 CE**, and his reign is considered a golden period due to economic growth, administrative efficiency, and cultural progress.
 
• Kulottunga I expanded the Chola kingdom, maintaining its dominance in South India and Southeast Asia, particularly in regions such as Sri Lanka and parts of Southeast Asia (e.g., Srivijaya).
